11. The Great Inventor

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: For years, a villager has wanted to build a small boat and explore the distant coastline.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: For years, (name1) has wanted to build a small boat and explore the distant coastline. (He/She) has gathered sketches, studied the currents, and imagined the journey many times. But other things have occupied (his/her) attention, and the boat remains unfinished.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (name1) spends the afternoon shaping a piece of wood. The work is slow but satisfying. By sunset the boat is still nowhere near ready. (name1) doesn't mind. It is a little closer than it was yesterday.

a__text.name: Answer A

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: (name1) goes swimming, eats a delicious meal, and spends the evening with friends. The boat remains unfinished. Tomorrow, next season, or perhaps several years from now, (he/she) may return to it. For today, (name1) is happy where (he/she) is.
